svg.title: Line of sight — 039 / After the weights reveal — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Line of sight: 039 / After the weights reveal, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold dark. Observation islands: response hatched, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights hatched. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Propositions and observations are pictograms beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: THE GROUND REMAINS. P2 RE-FOGS; P1 LOSES ITS OUTER FOOTHOLD.
039.3,5–6 / injection reading; OAI-BH weights channel; unresolved conflict · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
